text: The fellow at the next desk works very late.
translation: 隔壁桌那位男同事工作得很晚。

text: That young fellow wants to learn two languages.
translation: 那个年轻人想学两门语言。

text: A nice old fellow lives across the road.
translation: 路对面住着一位 nice 老头。

text: The fellow looked tired after the long shift.
translation: 那个男的下了长班后看起来很累。

text: My fellow says the whole thing was wrong.
translation: 我的同伴说整件事都错了。

text: She was a dear fellow to all of us here.
translation: 她是我们这里人人喜爱的伙伴。

text: He has been a real fellow since school days.
translation: 从上学起他就是个好朋友。

text: My fellow gave me half his bread.
translation: 我的朋友给了我半个面包。

text: Nobody here is such a kind fellow as she is.
translation: 这里没有谁像她这样好的朋友。

text: I met a pleasant fellow on the train.
translation: 我在火车上遇到一位和气的朋友。

text: The two young fellows talked about books.
translation: 那两个年轻人谈论书本。

text: Fellow students share the same small room.
translation: 同学朋友们共用那间小屋。

text: She felt no fellow feeling among them all.
translation: 在他们当中她感到格格不入。

text: He is not my fellow worker any more.
translation: 他不再是我的同行了。

text: No fellow citizen needs to fear the police.
translation: 没有哪个公民需要害怕警察。

text: Her fellow doctors met her at the door.
translation: 她的医生同事们在门口迎接她。

text: A fellow worker told me the whole story.
translation: 一个同事把整件事告诉了我。

text: He will meet his fellow teachers on Monday.
translation: 他周一要见他的教师同事们。

text: Her fellow students paid for the small gift.
translation: 她的同学们付了那份小礼物的钱。

text: Every fellow lawyer knows that old rule.
translation: 每位律师同行都知道那条老规矩。
